## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private inventory, personal data or school data.
- [ ] No private deployment details or real hostnames/IPs/MACs/serials.

- [ ] Secret scan considered.
- [ ] Code contributions are Apache-2.0; documentation is CC BY 4.0.
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`).
